registered: 2026-11-25 (lane L2 cycle 11), before any request of this journey was sent
how: Judged only from the results file of a run: what the person sees after each step and the Decision requests of that step. Hard = the journey is broken for the person if it fails; soft = expected but known to be fragile or already reported. "predicted" records what this lane expects to fail and why, written before the real run.

expect.text: The first answer is prepared with the A company request and quote v1 pages, and with no PostgreSQL or SQLite page.
The Agent's answer is posted once, as written (the draft check passes it).
No wait or pointer message for a short turn.
No page already delivered in the first turn is delivered again.
The follow-up answer is posted as the Agent wrote it.
expect.predicted: fails: finding A1 (the draft check has no evidence for held pages and rewrites the answer)

expect.text: Exactly one Agent message for the turn.
The briefing of the follow-up answer ends on the board, with at least two cards.
The board has a timeline part (what happened, in date order).
expect.predicted: fails: ontology pages reach the briefing without a date (pagesFromCandidates keeps only the time slice), so no part in date order is enumerated

expect.text: The board has a remaining-work part (what is still not done).
expect.predicted: fails: ontology nodes outside a snapshot carry no status, so no material is open

expect.text: The briefing adds no chat message.
Ten seconds into a running command, one wait message is posted.
The command line is not in any chat message.
The command's output is not in the heartbeat's judgment (the command-state judge reads it by design and is not covered here).
After forty silent seconds at most one stalled line is posted.
The command line is still not in any chat message.
The answer is posted and the run ends.
Exactly one Agent message.
With work placement advisory, nothing is posted when the result needs the owner elsewhere.
The placement is still decided and recorded.
With work placement on, exactly one pointer message tells the owner where the result is.
Exactly one new message.
The status remark starts one run only (the record of it is a side judgment, not a second run).
The remark is kept as a pending reading of the migration plan page; no page is changed.
The turn is prepared with the migration plan page and no A company page.
The browser task asks which business once, and the conversation is open for the reply.
Nothing is clicked or opened before the person answers.
The reply goes into the run that asked.
The task opens the second business and its invoice download, in that order.
One Agent message reports the result.
The finished task is written as a page of this conversation.

caps: Per step: about three times the requests and two and a half times the estimated input tokens of the dry run (independentEstimate of helper/egdesk-decision-real-runner.mjs), at least 4 requests and 4000 tokens. The journey total is capped separately (default 80000 tokens, 80 requests).
